nodes.name: CMTSceneManager.h
nodes.summary: Declares the scene-level PMX, VMD, and VPD orchestration API together with structured result logs for import and export operations. / 声明场景级 PMX、VMD 与 VPD 编排 API，并定义导入导出操作的结构化结果日志。

nodes.name: CMTSceneManager
nodes.summary: Constructs the per-document scene manager used by MMD import and export workflows. / 构造供 MMD 导入导出流程使用的按文档场景管理器。

nodes.name: ~CMTSceneManager
nodes.summary: Releases the per-document scene manager and its tracked runtime state. / 释放按文档存在的场景管理器及其跟踪的运行时状态。

nodes.name: IOLog
nodes.summary: Base diagnostic state providing shared memory and file I/O error dialogs with operation timing. / 基础诊断状态，提供共享的内存与文件读写错误对话框及操作计时。

nodes.name: LoadVmdCameraLog
nodes.summary: Tracks imported VMD camera frame counts and reports camera-specific success or validation failures. / 跟踪导入的 VMD 相机帧数，并报告相机相关成功或校验失败。

nodes.name: SaveVmdCameraLog
nodes.summary: Reports VMD camera export completion and elapsed time. / 报告 VMD 相机导出完成状态与耗时。

nodes.name: ConversionVmdCameraLog
nodes.summary: Carries timing state for camera conversion reporting. / 保存相机转换报告所需的计时状态。

nodes.name: LoadVmdMotionLog
nodes.summary: Accumulates imported motion counts and unmatched bone or morph names for detailed VMD reports. / 累积导入动作数量及未匹配骨骼或变形名称，用于详细 VMD 报告。

nodes.name: SaveVmdMotionLog
nodes.summary: Tracks exported VMD bone, morph, and frame counts and exposes validation error reports. / 跟踪导出的 VMD 骨骼、变形与帧数量，并提供校验错误报告。

nodes.name: LoadVpdPoseLog
nodes.summary: Tracks matched and unmatched VPD pose bones and morphs for import diagnostics. / 跟踪 VPD 姿势导入中匹配与未匹配的骨骼和变形。

nodes.name: SaveVpdPoseLog
nodes.summary: Tracks exported VPD bone and morph counts and reports selection or model errors. / 跟踪导出的 VPD 骨骼与变形数量，并报告选择或模型错误。

nodes.name: LoadModelLog
nodes.summary: Captures imported PMX metadata and enabled element counts for the completion report. / 捕获导入的 PMX 元数据与已启用元素数量，用于完成报告。

nodes.name: SavePmxModelLog
nodes.summary: Captures exported PMX metadata and element counts for the completion report. / 捕获导出的 PMX 元数据与元素数量，用于完成报告。

nodes.name: CMTSceneManager
nodes.summary: Per-document singleton that coordinates MMD model managers and camera objects across import and export workflows. / 按文档存在的单例，负责在导入导出流程中协调 MMD 模型管理器与相机对象。

nodes.name: cmt_tools_config_manager.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements configuration loading, default initialization, dialog synchronization, and JSON persistence for tool settings. / 实现工具设置的配置加载、默认值初始化、对话框同步与 JSON 持久化。

nodes.name: InitDialog
nodes.summary: Copies typed configuration values into matching Cinema 4D dialog controls. / 将类型化配置值复制到对应的 Cinema 4D 对话框控件。

nodes.name: InitConfig
nodes.summary: Seeds a configuration entry from its declared default while preserving any compatible persisted value. / 从声明的默认值初始化配置项，同时保留类型兼容的持久化值。

nodes.name: InitConfigManager
nodes.summary: Loads the JSON configuration, initializes the full setting table, and writes defaults when no file exists. / 加载 JSON 配置、初始化完整设置表，并在文件不存在时写入默认值。

nodes.name: SaveConfig
nodes.summary: Serializes the current configuration table to the configured JSON file. / 将当前配置表序列化到指定 JSON 文件。

nodes.name: cmt_tools_config_manager.h
nodes.summary: Defines the singleton configuration manager and its typed configuration table used by plugin dialogs and startup code. / 定义单例配置管理器及其类型化配置表，供插件对话框和启动代码使用。
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a C++ variant-backed table with templated getters and setters to keep heterogeneous settings type-safe. / 使用基于 C++ variant 的表和模板化读写接口，使异构设置保持类型安全。

nodes.name: CMTToolConfigManager
nodes.summary: Constructs the singleton configuration manager and its default setting table. / 构造单例配置管理器及其默认设置表。

nodes.name: operator =
nodes.summary: Disables or controls assignment for the singleton configuration manager. / 禁用或控制单例配置管理器的赋值。

nodes.name: CMTToolConfigManager
nodes.summary: Singleton service that owns typed tool settings, default declarations, dialog binding, and JSON persistence. / 单例服务，负责类型化工具设置、默认值声明、对话框绑定与 JSON 持久化。

nodes.name: cmt_tools_manager.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the high-level commands that import and export VMD cameras, motions, VPD poses, and PMX models through libMMD and the scene manager. / 实现通过 libMMD 与场景管理器导入导出 VMD 相机、动作、VPD 姿势和 PMX 模型的高层命令。

nodes.name: ImportVMDCamera
nodes.summary: Reads and imports VMDCamera data into the active Cinema 4D document through the scene manager. / 读取 VMDCamera 数据，并通过场景管理器导入当前 Cinema 4D 文档。

nodes.name: ConversionCamera
nodes.summary: Converts the selected Cinema 4D camera representation through the scene manager. / 通过场景管理器转换选定的 Cinema 4D 相机表示。

nodes.name: ExportVMDCamera
nodes.summary: Collects VMDCamera data from the active scene and writes it through the matching MMD serializer. / 从当前场景收集 VMDCamera 数据，并通过对应的 MMD 序列化器写出。

nodes.name: ImportVMDMotion
nodes.summary: Reads and imports VMDMotion data into the active Cinema 4D document through the scene manager. / 读取 VMDMotion 数据，并通过场景管理器导入当前 Cinema 4D 文档。

nodes.name: ImportVPDPose
nodes.summary: Reads and imports VPDPose data into the active Cinema 4D document through the scene manager. / 读取 VPDPose 数据，并通过场景管理器导入当前 Cinema 4D 文档。

nodes.name: ExportVPDPose
nodes.summary: Collects VPDPose data from the active scene and writes it through the matching MMD serializer. / 从当前场景收集 VPDPose 数据，并通过对应的 MMD 序列化器写出。

nodes.name: ExportVMDMotion
nodes.summary: Collects VMDMotion data from the active scene and writes it through the matching MMD serializer. / 从当前场景收集 VMDMotion 数据，并通过对应的 MMD 序列化器写出。

nodes.name: ImportPMXModel
nodes.summary: Reads and imports PMXModel data into the active Cinema 4D document through the scene manager. / 读取 PMXModel 数据，并通过场景管理器导入当前 Cinema 4D 文档。

nodes.name: ExportPMXModel
nodes.summary: Collects PMXModel data from the active scene and writes it through the matching MMD serializer. / 从当前场景收集 PMXModel 数据，并通过对应的 MMD 序列化器写出。

nodes.summary: Declares the public tool-command surface for camera, motion, pose, and model import and export. / 声明相机、动作、姿势与模型导入导出的公共工具命令接口。

nodes.name: main.cpp
nodes.summary: Provides the Cinema 4D plugin lifecycle entry points, registering components and initializing or saving shared configuration. / 提供 Cinema 4D 插件生命周期入口，负责注册组件并初始化或保存共享配置。

nodes.name: PluginStart
nodes.summary: Registers all plugin entities and initializes name-conversion and configuration services at startup. / 在启动时注册全部插件实体，并初始化名称转换与配置服务。

nodes.name: PluginEnd
nodes.summary: Persists shared tool configuration during plugin shutdown. / 在插件关闭时持久化共享工具配置。

nodes.name: PluginMessage
nodes.summary: Handles Cinema 4D system messages required for resource initialization and plugin integration. / 处理资源初始化与插件集成所需的 Cinema 4D 系统消息。
